summary: Geometry is correct everywhere: every probe strip spans lip to low road with no gap or overlap, and no risers show. All 40 ramps pass, as do all 8 grass stairs (opus3 village reads well). 32 stairs fail. Sand and cave: dark-brown framed boxes that read as crates/drawers/pallets. Snow: dark slate panels with white dashes, or shutters at h3-4. Peat: flat ribbed mats with no lit nosings. Tread tops should be valued like the ground they cut into.
